title: IES Optimiser input, format 1
description: A canonical IES Optimiser case: inputs only, with "format_version": 1. Unversioned legacy documents are accepted by IES Optimiser through its compatibility adapter, not by this schema. This schema describes structure only. Unique identifiers, references between objects, thermal topology, profile files and their contents and lengths, hourly shortfall bounds and thermodynamic admissibility are checked by IES Optimiser (ies-optimiser validate CASE.json). A valid case may still define an infeasible optimisation problem.

CommodityDemand.description:
Final demand for a Power-to-X commodity (heat, hydrogen, water...).

A demand with ``total`` 0 is inactive: it builds nothing, and its penalty,
shortfall bounds and profile are not read.

iden.description: Identifier of the commodity, unique among demands.
iden.title: Identifier

anyOf.description: a CSV file path (one value per line, no header), or '' for a flat profile

profile.description: Shape of hourly demand. Hourly shape: '' for a flat profile, a CSV file path (resolved against the input file's directory, or an explicit profile base; never the working directory), or a list with one value per hour (8760). Values must be finite, non-negative and not all zero.
profile.title: Profile

total.description: Annual demand in the commodity's unit (m3, kg, MWh of heat...). 0 makes the demand inactive.
total.title: Annual total

supply_sources.description: Identifiers of the processes (p2x) that deliver this commodity. A process may supply at most one active demand.
supply_sources.title: Supply sources

var_cost_ns.description: Penalty per unit of unmet demand (USD per unit). Required when the demand is active.
var_cost_ns.title: Shortfall penalty

l_ns.description: [low, high] bounds on unmet demand in each hour. Required, as a pair, when the demand is active; an inactive demand may give [] or omit it.
l_ns.title: Shortfall bounds

CommodityDemand.title: CommodityDemand

Demand.description: Final demands: electricity (``e``) and Power-to-X commodities (``x``).
Demand.title: Demand

anyOf.description: a CSV file path (one value per line, no header), or '' for a flat profile

profile.description: Shape of hourly demand. Hourly shape: '' for a flat profile, a CSV file path (resolved against the input file's directory, or an explicit profile base; never the working directory), or a list with one value per hour (8760). Values must be finite, non-negative and not all zero.
profile.title: Profile

total.description: Annual demand (MWh). The hourly series is the profile scaled so that it sums to this total.
total.title: Annual total

supply_sources.description: Unused for electricity, which is always met by the generators; kept for symmetry with commodity demands.
supply_sources.title: Supply sources

var_cost_ns.description: Penalty per unit of unmet demand (USD/MWh). Zero makes a shortfall free (the hourly bound still applies).
var_cost_ns.title: Shortfall penalty

l_ns.description: [low, high] bounds on unmet demand in EACH hour (MWh), not on the annual total. The effective upper bound is min(high, demand of the hour); low may not exceed the demand of any hour.
l_ns.title: Shortfall bounds

Generator.description: A power generator; a cogeneration unit can also supply heat to one process.

type.description: 'elec', or 'elec + ther' for a unit that can supply heat in cogeneration mode.
type.title: Kind

anyOf.description: a CSV file path (one value per line, no header), or '' for a flat profile

profile.description: Availability shape. Hourly shape: '' for a flat profile, a CSV file path (resolved against the input file's directory, or an explicit profile base; never the working directory), or a list with one value per hour (8760). Values must be finite, non-negative and not all zero. A profile supplies shape only: it is divided by its maximum and rescaled so that its mean equals capacity_factor.
profile.title: Profile

capacity_factor.description: Fraction in [0, 1]: the target mean of the rescaled profile, or a flat hourly ceiling when there is no profile.
capacity_factor.title: Capacity factor

fix_cost_prod.description: Fixed cost (USD per MW per year). Negative values are accepted (a subsidy).
fix_cost_prod.title: Fixed cost

var_emis_prod.description: Emissions (kg CO2eq/MWh). Negative values represent removal.
var_emis_prod.title: Emission factor

l_prod.description: [low, high] bounds on the installed capacity (MW), not on hourly output.
l_prod.title: Capacity bounds

c_prod.description: Installed capacity (MW); -1 lets the optimiser choose it within capacity_bounds.
c_prod.title: Capacity

Generator.title: Generator

Process.description:
A Power-to-X process: a production unit and a product store (serialised in ``p2x``).

Quantities are in the product's unit Q (m3 of water, kg of hydrogen, MWh of heat).

type.description: 'elec' (electricity only) or 'elec + ther' (electricity and heat from cogeneration units).
type.title: Kind

temperature.description: Steam extraction temperature (degC). Required for 'elec + ther'; unused otherwise.
temperature.title: Extraction temperature

anyOf.description: a CSV file path (one value per line, no header), or '' for a flat profile

profile.description: Availability shape, as for generators. Hourly shape: '' for a flat profile, a CSV file path (resolved against the input file's directory, or an explicit profile base; never the working directory), or a list with one value per hour (8760). Values must be finite, non-negative and not all zero.
profile.title: Profile

supply_sources.description: 'elec + ther' only: identifiers of the cogeneration generators supplying heat. A generator may supply one process.
supply_sources.title: Heat sources

fix_cost_prod.description: Fixed cost (USD per Q/h per year).
fix_cost_prod.title: Production fixed cost

l_prod.description: [low, high] bounds on the installed production capacity (Q/h).
l_prod.title: Production capacity bounds

c_prod.description: Production capacity (Q/h); -1 lets the optimiser choose it.
c_prod.title: Production capacity

fix_cost_strg.description: Fixed cost of product storage (USD per Q per year).
fix_cost_strg.title: Storage fixed cost

l_strg.description: [low, high] bounds on the installed storage capacity (Q).
l_strg.title: Storage capacity bounds

c_strg.description: Storage capacity (Q); -1 lets the optimiser choose it.
c_strg.title: Storage capacity

soc_ini.description: Store level at the start of the year, as a fraction of capacity; the year closes on the same level.
soc_ini.title: Initial state of charge

Process.title: Process

Storage.description: An electricity store (battery, pumped hydro), optionally fed by natural inflow (serialised in ``flex``).

fix_cost_strg.description: Fixed cost (USD per MWh of capacity per year).
fix_cost_strg.title: Fixed cost

hours_of_storage.description: Hours at full discharge: charge and discharge power are limited to capacity / duration_hours (h, > 0).
hours_of_storage.title: Duration hours

l_strg.description: [low, high] bounds on the installed energy capacity (MWh).
l_strg.title: Capacity bounds

c_strg.description: Energy capacity (MWh); -1 lets the optimiser choose it.
c_strg.title: Capacity

soc_ini.description: Level at the start of the year, as a fraction of capacity; the year closes on the same level.
soc_ini.title: Initial state of charge

soc_min.description: Lowest level, as a fraction of capacity.
soc_min.title: Min state of charge

soc_max.description: Highest level, as a fraction of capacity.
soc_max.title: Max state of charge

inflow_total.description: Natural inflow per year (MWh); 0 means none.
inflow_total.title: Annual inflow

anyOf.description: a CSV file path (one value per line, no header), or '' for a flat profile

inflow_profile.description: Shape of the inflow, scaled to annual_inflow. Absent or '' means flat. Hourly shape: '' for a flat profile, a CSV file path (resolved against the input file's directory, or an explicit profile base; never the working directory), or a list with one value per hour (8760). Values must be finite, non-negative and not all zero.
inflow_profile.title: Inflow profile

charge_allowed.description: false forbids charging from the grid (a dam fed only by its catchment).
charge_allowed.title: Charge allowed

Storage.title: Storage

format_version.description: Input format version. Must be 1; an input without it is read as a legacy document.
format_version.title: Format version
